title: Among customers who paid in either Czech koruna (CZK) or euros (EUR), which
question: Among customers who paid in either Czech koruna (CZK) or euros (EUR), which segment—SME, LAM, or KAM—had the highest total gas consumption in 2012, and by how much did it exceed the segment with the lowest consumption?

prediction.sql:
WITH segment_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.XCL_002 AS segment,
        SUM(ym.XCL_021) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON c.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    WHERE c.XCL_003 IN ('CZK', 'EUR')
      AND ym.XCL_020 BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_002
)
SELECT
    segment,
    total_consumption - (SELECT MIN(total_consumption) FROM segment_totals) AS difference
FROM segment_totals
ORDER BY total_consumption DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH segment_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.XCL_002 AS segment,
        SUM(ym.XCL_021) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON c.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    WHERE c.XCL_003 IN ('CZK', 'EUR')
      AND ym.XCL_020 BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_002
)
SELECT
    segment,
    total_consumption - (SELECT MIN(total_consumption) FROM segment_totals) AS difference
FROM segment_totals
ORDER BY total_consumption DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH filtered_transactions AS (
    SELECT 
        t.XCL_013,
        t.XCL_014,
        t.XCL_015,
        t.XCL_016,
        t.XCL_017,
        t.XCL_018,
        t.XCL_011,
        t.XCL_012,
        c.XCL_002,
        c.XCL_003
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
    WHERE t.XCL_012 IN ('CZK', 'EUR')
      AND t.XCL_011 >= '2012-01-01'
      AND t.XCL_011 < '2013-01-01'
),
segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.XCL_003 AS segment,
        SUM(ft.XCL_018) AS total_consumption
    FROM filtered_transactions ft
    JOIN customers c ON ft.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
    WHERE c.XCL_003 IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.XCL_003
),
ranked_segments AS (
    SELECT 
        segment,
        total_consumption,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_consumption DESC) AS rank_desc,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_consumption ASC) AS rank_asc
    FROM segment_consumption
)
SELECT 
    MAX(CASE WHEN rank_desc = 1 THEN segment END) AS highest_segment,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rank_desc = 1 THEN total_consumption END) - 
    MAX(CASE WHEN rank_asc = 1 THEN total_consumption END) AS difference
FROM ranked_segments
